maya: quick update 101 brought up q5-ash (adaptive-handshake) on a single titan-ops node for targeted long-form smoke. seeing ~2.3x token throughput vs fp16 for seq=1024,batch=4.

rishi: nice. perf numbers? p50/p95/p99?

maya: p50 15ms (fp16 36ms), p95 40ms (fp16 88ms), p99 90ms (fp16 180ms). bench command below.

maya: ```
# bench invocation
./bench --model q5-ash --seq 1024 --batch 4 --ash-mode=adaptive --warmup 500 --measure=latency,throughput
```

lucy: what eval set did you use for quality checks? long-only? mixed? decoding params?

maya: Eval: 1k long-only prompts (>=512 tokens), domain mix: docs/summaries/qa. decoding: beam=5 for verifier path, sampling top-p=0.92 temp=0.8 for raw path; seeds fixed. Ran three variants: raw q5-ash (no verifier), ash+verifier (rerank beams, fp16 verifier), and hybrid (verifier every 64 tokens).

rishi: results?

maya: TL;DR: raw q5-ash throughput win but quality hit. details:
- BLEU-like summary metric (proxy): fp16=46.1, q5-ash raw=44.7, ash+verifier=45.9, hybrid=45.5
- hallucination rate (our corpus): fp16=0.9%, q5-ash raw=2.6%, ash+verifier=1.1%, hybrid=1.6%
- avg tokens to first disagreement (with fp16): raw=1.8 tokens, hybrid=0.9 tokens

lucy: interesting that verifier recovers most but not all. what's verifier overhead?

maya: ash+verifier latency increase ~+11% p50 vs raw q5-ash (still below fp16 p50). Hybrid adds ~+5% but reduces compute cost vs always-on verifier. Rerank cost dominated by running fp16 verifier for top-5 beams; we measured verifier cpu/gpu util patterns in artifacts.

evalbot: CI 6130000000-a finished: artifacts -> s3://redwood-evals/6130000000/q5-ash/
Metrics summary attached.

rishi: can we narrow failure modes? where hallucinations spike?

maya: stratified results: most regressions on: (a) instruction-following with multi-step reasoning, (b) long context summarization with many named entities, (c) conversational QA with ambiguous coreference. Per-prompt metadata included in artifacts.

lucy: any signal from logits drift / calibration test?

maya: did calibration sweep: three schemes (minmax, percentile-99.99, per-channel scale) for q5 quant matrices. percentile-based reduced extreme drift but didn't fully close gap. logit delta histograms in s3 link. also saw more top-k reorderings in low-entropy tails.

rishi: propose rollout plan: start canary with hybrid verifier (every N=64 tokens) at 5% traffic, plus an offline rerank monitor for long-tail examples. add an alert that triggers rollback if hallucination-rate increases >0.7pp for 10m.

lucy: agree, and add a grace policy: if token-disagreement rate >3% persist for 5m on a user cohort, switch traffic for that cohort to fp16.

maya: noted. I'll produce a short canary runbook with expected cost overhead numbers (est +12% compute for hybrid, +30% for full verifier). Also will attach per-domain stratified fail list for targeted regression tests.

ops-bot: Canary window proposed: cluster=eng-dedicated, start=2026-04-02T03:30Z, duration=2h, traffic=5% (manual pause allowed).

rishi: also request a focused adversarial set: 200 prompts pulled from our hallucination corpus but masked to be long-context. want to run ash+verifier vs fp16 vs raw q5-ash and get per-example diff.

maya: already queued that job (6130000000-adversarial) and will push artifacts to the s3 path.

evalbot: note: retention 30 days; tag runs with {variant,qcalibration,verifier-mode,seed}.

lucy: final ask before canary: add telemetry for per-token rerank delta, emitter for top-1 vs top-5 reorder counts, and an end-to-end user-visible latency bucket so SLO alerts can be tuned.

maya: will add telemetry. uploading summary + run artifacts to s3 now. link in canary doc when ready.

rishi: cool. thanks maya + lucy. lets reconvene after adversarial runs and calibration ablation. :white_check_mark:
